raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Why

The K3 DistMuon recipe currently leaves the entire vision encoder on AdamW, including its matrix-valued linear weights. Extend the existing recipe so vision Q/K/V projections get per-head Muon updates and the other vision linear weights get whole-matrix updates.

For example, in the debug model:

```text
vision_encoder.layers.0.attn.wq.weight: [512, 256]
main:    AdamW on the packed parameter
this PR: DistMuon on four independent [128, 256] head matrices
head_dim = attention.dim / num_heads, not vision_encoder.dim / num_heads
```

This belongs in the optimizer recipe: existing `BlockShard` and `Owned` layouts already express these matrices. A blanket "all 2D parameters" rule would incorrectly include learned position embeddings and would not preserve Q/K/V head boundaries.

## What changed

- Add explicit vision parameter selection and compute layouts: per-head Q/K/V; whole-matrix attention output, MLP, patch embedding, and multimodal projector weights.
- Keep vision buckets separate from decoder buckets. Vision uses a `dp_shard` FSDP mesh, while CP-enabled decoder parameters use `dp_shard_cp`.
- Keep norms and learned position embeddings on AdamW. The debug recipe changes from 228 Muon + 237 AdamW parameters to 243 Muon + 222 AdamW parameters.
- Add coverage and document the optimizer assignment. Model forward code and parameter/checkpoint layouts are unchanged; optimizer states saved with the old vision AdamW assignment require reinitialization or migration.

## Numerics

Validated on a branch based on `2db551367`, using seed 42 and deterministic algorithms.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 10-step `kimi_k3_debugmodel_mm_muon`, FSDP2 + EP2, 2 GB300 GPUs | Loss and gradient norm are bitwise identical to independent seeded repeat runs |
| Debug training loss | Step 1: 7.983359336853027; step 10: 6.552382469177246 |
| Vision update reference | DistMuon update directions match independent per-head/whole-matrix `torch.optim.Muon` within the existing BF16 Newton-Schulz tolerance; AdamW updates match exactly |

The training check uses `scripts/loss_compare.py` with `--metrics=loss,grad_norm --steps=10 --baseline-ngpus=2 --test-ngpus=2`, baseline/test config `tests.integration_tests.b200:kimi_k3_debugmodel_mm_muon`, seed config `tests.integration_tests.b200:kimi_k3_debugmodel_mm`, and `--import-result=<previous-run.txt> --assert-equal`.

This intentionally changes optimizer updates and therefore the post-step-1 golden losses. The 10-step debug run is a smoke/reproducibility check, not real-data convergence evidence.

## Testing

**28 targeted tests passed**, including:

- CPU coverage against actual debug/full model parameters built on meta: every vision linear weight is selected, Q/K/V use the projected head width, embeddings/norms remain AdamW, and buckets do not mix vision/decoder transport groups. Covers CP degree 1 and 2 and a configuration without vision.
- Two-GPU FSDP update comparison, with an FSDP shard boundary that splits a vision head; image/image, image/text, and all-text batches; optimizer `state_dict` save/load followed by further updates.
- Existing Hugging Face state-dict round trip and decoder grouped-linear DistMuon coverage.

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,3 python -m pytest \
  tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/kimi_k3 \
  tests/unit_tests/gpu/models/kimi_k3/test_kimi_k3_dist_muon.py \
  tests/unit_tests/gpu/models/kimi_k3/test_kimi_k3.py::TestKimiK3::test_state_dict_round_trips_through_hf_adapter \
  tests/unit_tests/gpu/models/kimi_k3/test_kimi_k3.py::TestKimiK3::test_dist_muon_config_uses_native_grouped_linear_fqns \
  -q
```

The new GPU test is marked `multi_gpu` and selected by the existing GPU unit-test workflow. The existing B200 `kimi_k3_mm_muon` integration recipe already exercises this default optimizer.

`pre-commit run --all-files`: all hooks pass except three pre-existing local Pyrefly errors in the installed `torch_checkpointing` API and PyAV types. The changed recipe type-checks with zero errors; no unrelated lint-generated changes are included.

## Before Merge

- [ ] Regenerate `tests/assets/losses/real_pg/kimi_k3_b200.txt` on B200. Do not substitute GB300 results: an unchanged upstream run at `109ba1113` already differed from that golden on the local GB300 setup.
- [ ] Validate convergence on representative real multimodal data.

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("flavor", ("debugmodel", "Kimi-K3"))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("context_parallel_degree", (1, 2))
+def test_dist_muon_covers_vision_linear_weights(
+    flavor: str, context_parallel_degree: int
+) -> None:
+    parallelism = ParallelismConfig(context_parallel_degree=context_parallel_degree)
+    model_config = build_model_config(
+        flavor, seq_len=16, parallelism=parallelism, attn_backend="varlen"
+    )
+    optimizer_config = _dist_muon_optimizer(
+        model_config, muon_lr=1e-3, adamw_lr=1e-3, parallelism=parallelism
+    )
+    muon_config, adamw_config = optimizer_config.optimizers
+    assert isinstance(muon_config, DistMuon.Config)
+    assert isinstance(adamw_config, AdamW.Config)
+
+    with torch.device("meta"):
+        model = model_config.build()
+    parameters = dict(model.named_parameters())
+    vision_linear_names = {
+        f"{name}.weight"
+        for name, module in model.named_modules()
+        if name.startswith("vision_encoder.") and isinstance(module, Linear)
+    }
+    vision_names = {name for name in parameters if name.startswith("vision_encoder.")}
+    claimed: set[str] = set()
+    muon_names = set(
+        OptimizersContainer._build_param_group(model, muon_config, claimed)[
+            "param_names"
+        ]
+    )
+    adamw_names = set(
+        OptimizersContainer._build_param_group(model, adamw_config, claimed)[
+            "param_names"
+        ]
+    )
+    assert muon_names == set(muon_config.compute_sharding_by_fqn)
+    assert muon_names & vision_names == vision_linear_names
+    assert adamw_names & vision_names == vision_names - vision_linear_names
+
+    vision_config = model_config.vision_encoder
+    assert vision_config is not None
+    assert len(vision_linear_names) == 6 * vision_config.num_layers + 3
+    assert "vision_encoder.pos_embed" in adamw_names
+    assert "vision_encoder.final_norm.weight" in adamw_names
+    assert "vision_encoder.projector.post_norm.weight" in adamw_names
+    attention_config = vision_config.block.attn
+    head_dim = attention_config.dim // attention_config.num_heads
+    for fqn in vision_linear_names:
+        layout = muon_config.compute_sharding_by_fqn[fqn]
+        assert layout.compute_dtype is torch.bfloat16
+        sharding = layout.shardings_by_mesh_axis["dp_shard"]
+        if fqn.endswith((".attn.wq.weight", ".attn.wk.weight", ".attn.wv.weight")):
+            assert sharding == BlockShard(dim=0, block_sizes=(head_dim,))
+            assert parameters[fqn].shape == (attention_config.dim, vision_config.dim)
+            assert (
+                sharding.num_blocks(parameters[fqn].shape[0])
+                == attention_config.num_heads
+            )
+        else:
+            assert isinstance(sharding, Owned)
+
+    bucketed_names = []
+    for bucket in muon_config.bucket_configs:
+        matches = {
+            fqn
+            for fqn in muon_names
+            if any(fnmatchcase(fqn, pattern) for pattern in bucket.patterns)
+        }
+        if matches & vision_names:
+            assert matches <= vision_names
+        bucketed_names.extend(matches)
+    assert sorted(bucketed_names) == sorted(muon_names)
+
+
+def test_dist_muon_without_vision_has_no_vision_layouts() -> None:

+    )
+    assert not any(

+    )

+# LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
+
+import copy
+import unittest
+from dataclasses import replace
+from typing import cast
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from torch.distributed.device_mesh import init_device_mesh
+from torch.distributed.fsdp import fully_shard, MixedPrecisionPolicy
+from torch.testing._internal.distributed._tensor.common_dtensor import (
+    DTensorTestBase,
+    with_comms,
+)
+
+from torchtitan.components.optim import AdamW, DistMuon
+from torchtitan.distributed.flex_shard.dist_muon import _adjust_muon_learning_rate
+from torchtitan.models.kimi_k3.flavors import _vision_encoder_config
+from torchtitan.models.kimi_k3.model import KimiK3Model
+from torchtitan_recipes.tests.models.kimi_k3 import (
+    _dist_muon_optimizer,
+    kimi_k3_debugmodel,
+)
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.multi_gpu
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.device_count() >= 2, "requires two CUDA devices")
+class TestKimiK3VisionDistMuon(DTensorTestBase):
+    @property
+    def world_size(self) -> int:
+        return 2
+
+    @property
+    def device_type(self) -> str:
+        return "cuda"
+
+    @with_comms
+    def test_fsdp_matches_independent_matrix_updates_and_resume(self) -> None:
+        torch.manual_seed(42)
+        device = torch.device(self.device_type, self.rank)
+        recipe = kimi_k3_debugmodel(seq_len=16)
+        model_config = cast(KimiK3Model.Config, recipe.model)
+        # Three heads force the two-rank FSDP storage boundary to split a head.
+        vision_config = _vision_encoder_config(
+            text_dim=model_config.dim,
+            dim=32,
+            qkv_dim=48,
+            hidden_dim=64,
+            num_layers=1,
+            num_heads=3,
+            patch_size=2,
+            init_pos_emb_height=2,
+            init_pos_emb_width=2,
+            max_num_frames=1,
+        )
+        model_config = replace(model_config, vision_encoder=vision_config)
+        optimizer_config = _dist_muon_optimizer(
+            model_config, muon_lr=1e-3, adamw_lr=1e-3, parallelism=recipe.parallelism
+        )
+        muon_config, adamw_config = optimizer_config.optimizers
+        self.assertIsInstance(muon_config, DistMuon.Config)
+        self.assertIsInstance(adamw_config, AdamW.Config)
+
+        with torch.device(device):
+            model = nn.Module()
+            model.vision_encoder = vision_config.build()
+            model.vision_encoder.init_states(buffer_device=device)
+        mesh = init_device_mesh(
+            self.device_type, (self.world_size,), mesh_dim_names=("dp_shard",)
+        )
+        fully_shard(
+            model.vision_encoder,
+            mesh=mesh,
+            mp_policy=MixedPrecisionPolicy(
+                param_dtype=torch.bfloat16, reduce_dtype=torch.float32
+            ),
+        )
+        optimizer = optimizer_config.build(model_parts=[model])
+        muon, adamw = optimizer.optimizers
+        parameters = dict(model.named_parameters())
+        muon_names = muon.param_groups[0]["param_names"]
+        adamw_names = adamw.param_groups[0]["param_names"]
+        head_dim = vision_config.block.attn.dim // vision_config.block.attn.num_heads
+        reference_parameters = {}
+        for fqn, parameter in parameters.items():
+            value = parameter.full_tensor().detach()
+            blocks = (
+                value.split(head_dim, dim=0)
+                if fqn.endswith(
+                    (".attn.wq.weight", ".attn.wk.weight", ".attn.wv.weight")
+                )
+                else (value,)
+            )
+            reference_parameters[fqn] = tuple(
+                nn.Parameter(block.clone()) for block in blocks
+            )
+
+        reference_muon = torch.optim.Muon(
+            [block for fqn in muon_names for block in reference_parameters[fqn]],
+            **{
+                name: getattr(muon_config, name)
+                for name in (
+                    "lr",
+                    "weight_decay",
+                    "momentum",
+                    "nesterov",
+                    "ns_coefficients",
+                    "eps",
+                    "ns_steps",
+                    "adjust_lr_fn",
+                )
+            },
+        )
+        reference_adamw = adamw_config.build(
+            params=[reference_parameters[fqn][0] for fqn in adamw_names]
+        )
+        generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(42 + self.rank)
+        decay = 1 - muon_config.lr * muon_config.weight_decay
+
+        for step in range(3):
+            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
+            # Text-only batches run dummy vision and contribute zero gradients.
+            has_image = step == 0 or (step == 1 and self.rank == 1)
+            grid_size = 4 if has_image else 2
+            grid_thw_N3 = torch.tensor([[1, grid_size, grid_size]], device=device)
+            pixel_values_TP = (
+                torch.randn(16, 12, device=device, generator=generator)
+                if has_image
+                else torch.zeros(4, 12, device=device)
+            )
+            target_TO = torch.randn(
+                grid_size**2 // 4,
+                model_config.dim,
+                device=device,
+                generator=generator,
+            )
+            output_TO = model.vision_encoder(pixel_values_TP, grid_thw=grid_thw_N3)
+            loss = (
+                (output_TO.float() - target_TO).square().mean()
+                if has_image
+                else (output_TO.float() * 0.0).sum()
+            )
+            self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(loss))
+            loss.backward()
+
+            actual_before = {}
+            reference_before = {}
+            for fqn, parameter in parameters.items():
+                self.assertIsNotNone(parameter.grad, fqn)
+                gradient = parameter.grad.full_tensor().detach()
+                blocks = reference_parameters[fqn]
+                gradients = (
+                    gradient.split(head_dim, dim=0) if len(blocks) > 1 else (gradient,)
+                )
+                for block, grad in zip(blocks, gradients, strict=True):
+                    block.grad = grad.clone()
+                if fqn in muon_names:
+                    actual_before[fqn] = parameter.full_tensor().detach().clone()
+                    reference_before[fqn] = (
+                        torch.cat([block.detach() for block in blocks], dim=0)
+                        if len(blocks) > 1
+                        else blocks[0].detach().clone()
+                    )
+
+            optimizer.step()
+            reference_muon.step()
+            reference_adamw.step()
+            for fqn, parameter in parameters.items():
+                blocks = reference_parameters[fqn]
+                expected = (
+                    torch.cat([block.detach() for block in blocks], dim=0)
+                    if len(blocks) > 1
+                    else blocks[0].detach()
+                )
+                actual = parameter.full_tensor().detach()
+                if fqn in adamw_names:
+                    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+                    continue
+                adjusted_lr = _adjust_muon_learning_rate(
+                    muon_config.lr, muon_config.adjust_lr_fn, blocks[0].shape
+                )
+                actual_update = (actual_before[fqn] * decay - actual) / adjusted_lr
+                expected_update = (
+                    reference_before[fqn] * decay - expected
+                ) / adjusted_lr
+                # Batched BF16 Newton-Schulz can differ slightly across GEMM schedules.
+                torch.testing.assert_close(
+                    actual_update, expected_update, rtol=0, atol=2e-2, msg=fqn
+                )
+
+            if step == 0:
+                state = copy.deepcopy(optimizer.state_dict())
+                optimizer = optimizer_config.build(model_parts=[model])
+                optimizer.load_state_dict(state)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
